subject: Model for the non-author agent nodes
statement: ok, so for the different model, from now on, use clause [claude]

clarifications.model: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), chosen by the owner among Fabro's catalogued models
clarifications.access: use my claude account, not API

decision: Inspectors and the Release Manager run on Claude (claude-opus-5) through the owner's Claude account login in an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, behind the forge ACP proxy and policy gates (ADR-0012). Authors stay on Codex Sol 6.1 (OD-2026-10-19-06). No Anthropic API key is used.
login: owner ran 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<data_root>/claude-home claude auth login' (claude.ai account); the owner's ~/.claude is not read or linked
not_changed: AFO model profiles (OBSERVE_ONLY policy); deterministic script nodes; runs already in flight (LL r167 keeps DeepSeek inspectors)

amendments.change: model claude-opus-5 -> claude-opus-5-5 (Opus 5.5); Fabro's model catalogue does not apply on the ACP path, where Claude Code takes the model ID; re-probed with identical gate results
